finalText:
**The build passes now.** One real error, in `src/core/settings.js`:

```
ERROR EBUILD01 link-failed: src/core/settings.js — ReferenceError: retries is not defined
```

`resolveConfig` read a bare `retries` that was never declared. It meant to read `env.retries`. I changed it to use `env.retries`, with a new `DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES = 3` when the caller leaves it out. That 3 is my guess — nothing in the repo said what it should be.

`build finished in 41.7s with 3 warnings, 0 errors`, exit 0.

The 3 warnings are all still there and none of them break anything:

| Code | Where |
| --- | --- |
| `W1042` deprecated `crypto.createCipher` | `src/legacy/adapter.js` |
| `W2213` unused export `formatLegacyDate` | `src/utils/format.js` |
| `W3307` circular import | `src/core/graph.js` ↔ `src/state/tracker.js` |

Those files aren't in the repo, so I left them alone.
